description: Suggest fresh content topics and manage your Marky content topics through the API. Use this when your posts feel repetitive or off-target, you want new things to post about, or you want to add, edit, enable, disable, or remove topics. Topics steer what Marky writes about, so a good topic list is the difference between focused content and random noise. Reads auth and endpoints from the marky-api skill. Also triggers on "what should I post about", "new content ideas", "my posts feel repetitive", "add a topic".
